# RandomFeatureReservoir

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reservoir computing-style architecture where a fixed random CNN acts as a high-dimensional, nonlinear feature space for downstream learning. Provides a biologically plausible, training-free feature extraction mechanism suitable for in-network neuromorphic cores with limited plasticity.
